name: Base Agent — Greets by name and calls get_session_history

chat_history.message: Hey Alex, good to have you here — ready to sharpen your discovery skills today?

success_conditions: Agent greets the trainee using their name (Alex)
Agent does not ask for their name or email verbally
Agent calls get_session_history with the correct email address (alex.test@example.com)
Agent does not proceed to persona selection before the tool returns a response
simulation_scenario: A new trainee named Alex logs in for the first time. The agent should greet them by name and immediately call get_session_history using their email before doing anything else.
